Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.SurgebindingAb.label: Windspren Shield
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.SurgebindingAb.description: Bind the air itself into a swirling barrier around you. The wind howls in a tight circle, catching arrows mid-flight and turning blades aside. Those standing close feel it too, the pressure of something solid that is not quite there, sheltering them from harm.
